name: Barbell Kneeling Squat
steps: Kneel upright on a folded towel or padded floor with knees hip-width apart and a barbell resting securely across your upper back.
Brace your abs firmly and keep your chest tall with a neutral spine.
Hinge back at your hips and bend your knees to lower your glutes smoothly toward your heels.
Drive your hips powerfully forward by squeezing your glutes until your torso and thighs form a vertical line.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked over your pelvis at the top instead of arching your lower back.
Keep your toes either tucked under or flat against the floor for consistent balance.
